title: Göbekli Tepe built and buried by survivors of a cataclysm

tellings.quote: Gobeclete in Turkey where we attributed that area to just hunter gatherers then lo and behold this you know incredible ancient the oldest megalithic temple site pops up out of the ground

plain: Göbekli Tepe, a hill site in Turkey, holds what is called the oldest temple of giant standing stones, and the story goes that it was built and later buried by people who survived a great disaster. A researcher named Jay Anderson brings it up without naming a source. He says experts had put the area down to simple hunter-gatherers, and then this ancient temple site "pops up out of the ground", which in his telling suggests the past was more advanced than we were taught.
